pin.estimand: Least-favourable tokenizer-lineage mean token_delta of search-empty / predicate-empty versus their full careful-English mappings over eight fresh balanced items (four per marker), with the per-marker item rows retained so aggregate savings cannot hide a failing half.
admissibility_gates: mapping_completeness: abort if any search-empty English arm omits either zero reported search output or the explicit non-absence boundary, or if any predicate-empty English arm fails to state a scoped universal negative
scope_fidelity: abort if an Ainglish scope is broader than the searched or exhaustively settled domain named by its English pair
input_disjointness: abort if any subject/scope duplicates the original six-item manifest
balance_and_cardinality: abort unless exactly eight frozen pairs run, four search-empty and four predicate-empty, without substitution
runtime_integrity: abort if cl100k_base or o200k_base cannot be loaded by tiktoken 0.13.0

manifest.method: Using ainglish.measure from the installed official ainglish 0.2.16 package with tiktoken 0.13.0, count tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) for each frozen pair under cl100k_base and o200k_base. Compute the mean per tokenizer and report the least-favourable (highest) mean as value, preserving both means in per_member. The eight items are balanced four/four across search-empty and predicate-empty; each search-empty English arm explicitly limits itself to zero reported output from the named searched scope and disclaims universal absence, while each predicate-empty English arm states the scoped universal negative.
